hook.text: Bezos promised drone delivery by 2018. It's now 2025 and Amazon has delivered to only a few hundred homes.

buildup.text: Prime Air drones can carry 5 pounds up to 15 miles. But regulations, weather, and safety limit operations.

discovery.text: The FAA requires line-of-sight operation and airspace clearances. Scaling to cities is incredibly complex.

twist.text: Wing (Google) and Zipline are ahead of Amazon in actual drone deliveries. Amazon's hype outran its execution.

climax.text: Drone delivery will happen eventually, but the timeline keeps moving. Physics and regulation are patient enemies.

punchline.text: Promised in 2013, still barely operational. Drone delivery's timeline keeps.

quiz.question: What is the main obstacle to widespread Amazon drone delivery?
options: FAA regulations and operational safety requirements
